Name: Custom_Finger_Scales
Description: Custom finger scaling system for independent phalange scaling. Parents all finger joints to Palm_Jnt and removes scale constraints for both L_ and R_ hands.

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Creates a system to scale each finger phalange independently.

How To Use:
  Build this block after your rig hand joints and controls exist.

Behavior:
- Parents all finger joints to Palm_Jnt for both L_ and R_.
- Removes all scale constraints from finger joints.
- Connects control scale attributes to joint scale with axis remap.
- Allows per-phalanx scaling for animation and rigging flexibility.
